solutions.name: ITIP
solutions.excerpt: A planned IT workspace for shared definitions, evidence review, scoped appraisal and generation.
solutions.tagline: The IT Intelligence Platform: a shared, governed account of the IT landscape, with planned analysis, appraisal, sourcing and generation.
solutions.description: An authenticated shell and account foundations exist. Domain workflows, scoped policy enforcement and integrated SIE access remain planned; hosted availability is not established.

capabilities.name: Governed IT definition inventory
capabilities.blurb: Maintain a shared IT inventory whose typed definitions, review decisions and access responsibilities stay connected across framework views. Browser authoring, tenant/object policy and identity synchronization remain planned beyond the existing authentication foundations.

capabilities.name: IT governance fabric composition
capabilities.blurb: Compose selected frameworks and internal obligations against a shared IT inventory, review overlaps and gaps, and retain revision-bound adoption decisions. Composition does not itself evaluate or enforce compliance.

capabilities.name: Evidence-backed IT definition sourcing
capabilities.blurb: Reconcile evidence-backed candidates from selected code revisions into reviewable IT definition drafts, with collection coverage, source age and recoverable runs visible throughout. Analysis and client-owned draft registration are planned; inspected source is not deployed reality.

capabilities.name: Scoped IT compliance evaluation
capabilities.blurb: Appraise scoped IT definitions, carry versioned findings into accountable corrective reviews, and reappraise revised proposals. Preserve applicability and unknown states; continuous live-system assurance additionally requires observations and scheduling.

capabilities.name: IT dependency analysis and decision support
capabilities.blurb: Assess proposed IT changes by combining dependency and obligation paths with cited, read-only answers over authorized definitions. Planned analysis exposes missing boundaries and insufficient evidence; causal simulation additionally needs validated scenario dynamics and explicit uncertainty.

capabilities.name: IT artifact generation
capabilities.blurb: Turn a selected IT baseline into consistent architecture and evidence document families, then review outputs against the definitions and decisions they cite. Recurring production retains pinned inputs and exposes incomplete jobs; generation is not substantive acceptance.

products.name: Web Application
products.tagline: Bring IT definitions, evidence and decisions into one shared workspace.
products.description: The authenticated application shell is available. Planned workflows connect inventory authoring, ontology composition, scoped appraisal, impact analysis and cited copilot answers through the BFF and SIE, with tenant/object access controls.

features.name: IT artifact factory
features.blurb: Generate ADR packs, architecture baselines, roadmaps and evidence summaries from pinned definitions and versioned templates. Maintain and preview bindings, specify narrative grounding, schedule recurring runs and inspect partial or failed jobs; review substantive quality before accepting each document.

milestone.label: IT artifact factory

features.name: IT compliance evaluation
features.blurb: Review scoped measures and findings with rule/input versions and explicit unknown or not-applicable results. Carry findings into owned corrective proposals and reappraise after change; live-system assessment additionally uses observation evidence.

milestone.label: IT compliance evaluation

features.name: IT Copilot
features.blurb: Ask read-only questions over authorized, versioned definitions and check answers through citations, snapshot age and explicit abstention when evidence is insufficient.

milestone.label: IT Copilot

features.name: IT impact analysis and planned simulation
features.blurb: Trace dependency and obligation paths, including cycles, retirement prerequisites and missing boundaries. Causal simulation is a further extension with validated dynamics and explicit uncertainty; retirement execution is separate.

milestone.label: IT impact simulation

features.name: GSM Definitions sourcing management
features.blurb: Configure repository branches, paths and revision boundaries, set refresh expectations, track durable runs and coverage, recover incomplete collection, reconcile candidates and register reviewed drafts idempotently, with visible failures and source age.

milestone.label: Truth sourcing management

features.name: GSM Definitions management
features.blurb: Author and revise definitions through the browser, BFF and Definition Manager, with lifecycle commands, actionable validation and stale-write feedback. Save selection/traversal lenses, inspect one subject across framework views and carry corrected proposals into renewed review.

milestone.label: MVP/GA — GSM Definitions & Ontology management, RBAC/ABAC, hardened

features.name: GSM Ontology management
features.blurb: Import and reuse pinned package selections, bind adopter scope, compare coverage against an explicit subject/concern inventory, review competing obligations with accountable interpretation and govern upgrades. Selection does not establish legal completeness.

milestone.label: MVP/GA — GSM Definitions & Ontology management, RBAC/ABAC, hardened

features.name: Authentication and planned RBAC/ABAC
features.blurb: Sign in and assign privileges today. Planned RBAC administration and ABAC will review and enforce tenant, object and action permissions against responsibilities.

milestone.label: MVP/GA — GSM Definitions & Ontology management, RBAC/ABAC, hardened

features.name: Identity-provider synchronization
features.blurb: Reconcile identities and groups from a configured provider with local assignments. Inspect sync health and failures, resynchronize idempotently and verify deprovisioning without granting authority from untrusted identity claims.

milestone.label: Identity synchronization and governance review sessions (unordered)

features.name: Governance review sessions
features.blurb: Prepare multi-item agendas, record participation and retain revision-bound decisions and conditions. Enforce authorized lifecycle commands separately from meeting votes, and reject stale decision targets.

milestone.label: Identity synchronization and governance review sessions (unordered)

products.name: Definition Blackboard Code Sourcer
products.tagline: Turn inspected code revisions into evidence-backed definition proposals.
products.description: The planned sourcer will analyze pinned repository revisions, initially for JVM projects, and prepare candidates for expert review. Source evidence describes the inspected revision; draft promotion and confirmation of deployed behavior are separate steps.

features.name: GSM Definitions candidate sourcing from code repos
features.blurb: Prepare typed, evidence-backed candidates from staged repository analysis, initially for JVM projects. Each language, API-contract, SBOM and infrastructure adapter declares its coverage; candidates pass through review before draft promotion.

milestone.label: MVP/GA — GSM Definitions automatic sourcing from code repos

solutions.name: SIE
solutions.excerpt: Definition, lifecycle, execution and intake foundations, with scoped integration work remaining.
solutions.tagline: The Systemic Intelligence Engine: a GSM reference implementation for governed definitions and bounded execution.
solutions.description: Retained definitions, transition controls, execution source and contribution intake exist. A regulator additionally needs identified observations, accepted evaluation, authorized action and feedback.

capabilities.name: Authoritative definition store
capabilities.blurb: Provide a common record of system definitions by combining stable identities, retained snapshots and API access to current and historical versions. Existing storage and APIs need acceptance for current grammar alignment, coherent pins, tenant/object authorization and verified retention policies.

capabilities.name: Governance lifecycle controls
capabilities.blurb: Control the progression from closed evidence collection to reviewed and activated definition revisions, keeping board sealing separate from approval. Existing transition controls need acceptance for identity-bound decisions, graded validation and concurrent intake integrity; committed-change notifications are a planned extension.

capabilities.name: Collaborative contribution intake
capabilities.blurb: Give collaborating sources a shared intake and retained evidence history so clients can compare contributions and revisit the basis for candidate selection. Panels and storage exist; end-to-end validation, complete auditing, client reconciliation and authorized draft promotion remain integration boundaries.

capabilities.name: Scoped Norm verdict evaluation
capabilities.blurb: Combine access to versioned governed definitions with pure applicability and assertion evaluation over pinned rules and supplied instances. Planned verdicts preserve non-evaluable states and support comparison of proposed rules without dispatching effects; coherent input selection needs acceptance, and running-system claims additionally require observations.

capabilities.name: Bounded Mechanism execution
capabilities.blurb: Translate eligible Mechanism definitions into effects through selected technology adapters under explicit execution and transport contracts. Existing execution and adapters need acceptance for atomic frames, caller authority, budgets, cancellation and partial or unknown outcome receipts; wider adapters are optional.

capabilities.name: Governed context for AI
capabilities.blurb: Supply AI clients with a shared, versioned definition context through direct APIs and planned MCP access, combining policy-filtered selection with bounded operations. API foundations exist; authorized selection and evaluated tool/answer boundaries still need acceptance. Direct authoring does not require sourcing.

products.name: Definition Manager
products.tagline: Keep system definitions versioned, accessible and governed through change.
products.description: REST APIs, retained snapshots and transition controls provide the current implementation scope. Tenant/object authorization, current graded validation and revision-bound decisions are being completed; committed change notifications and MCP access are planned.

features.name: GSM Definitions management RESTful API
features.blurb: Access Definitions and Ascriptions through the REST implementation. Completion covers current graded-create semantics, tenant/object policy and coherent queries.

milestone.label: MVP/GA — Definitions management API, lifecycle enforcement, retention

features.name: GSM Definitions lifecycle controls
features.blurb: Validate Ascription state transitions. Current graded checks, revision-bound decisions and differentiated cascades include inspecting dependent eligibility after foundation invalidation, beyond state legality alone.

milestone.label: MVP/GA — Definitions management API, lifecycle enforcement, retention

features.name: GSM Definitions retention
features.blurb: Retain versioned snapshots and stable identities. Retrieve historical decision evidence and agree purpose, duration, access and disposal constraints; decision attribution, recovery and verified policy enforcement remain completion boundaries.

milestone.label: MVP/GA — Definitions management API, lifecycle enforcement, retention

features.name: GSM Definitions lifecycle events mediation
features.blurb: Notify authorized consumers of committed changes, with ordering, replay, deduplication and crash recovery in a dedicated lifecycle event stream.

features.name: MCP

milestone.label: MCP

products.name: Operator

products.description: The execution implementation resolves eligible definitions and dispatches through selected adapters. Caller authority, execution budgets and failure handling remain integration boundaries. Planned pure Norm evaluation will return verdicts over pinned inputs without dispatching effects.

features.name: GSM Norms evaluation API
features.blurb: Evaluate applicability and assertions over pinned supplied inputs, with temporal windows and non-evaluable states, without dispatching effects. Compare old and proposed rule verdicts on reference inputs for caller-reviewed acceptance. Running-system claims additionally require observation evidence.

milestone.label: MVP/GA — GSM Norms evaluation API

features.name: GSM Mechanism execution foundations
features.blurb: Resolve requested eligible definitions and dispatch their effects. Further execution controls cover atomic frames, caller authority, budgets, cancellation and partial or unknown outcome receipts.

milestone.label: GSM Mechanism execution foundations

features.name: GSM Mechanism technology integrations
features.blurb: Connect execution through selected adapters. Planned additional adapters extend coverage independently of core execution, each with transport, authority and failure contracts.

products.name: Definition Blackboard Manager
products.tagline: Bring evidence and competing proposals into a shared review space.
products.description: Panels, contribution intake, retention and sequential sealing are implemented. Concurrent intake integrity and client integration remain in scope for completion. Clients reconcile candidates and promote drafts; sealing closes collection rather than approving a definition.

features.name: KS Contributions management RESTful API
features.blurb: Collect contributions in generic panels. Schema, identity, envelope and rejection behavior is defined per client/server integration, with end-to-end validation still to complete.

milestone.label: MVP/GA — contributions API, seal lifecycle, audit ledger

features.name: Blackboard seal lifecycle controls
features.blurb: Manage collection through OPEN, SEALING, SEALED and ABORTED states. Concurrent intake integrity and canonical snapshots remain under completion; definition approval happens after collection.

features.name: KS Contributions retention
features.blurb: Revisit stored contributions and their captured evidence. Complete mutation auditing, integrity, recovery and links to promoted drafts extend the retained history.

solutions.name: GSM
solutions.excerpt: Candidate definition semantics, selected sourced vocabulary and non-normative research.
solutions.tagline: The Generative System Model: a candidate common language for system definitions and governance.
solutions.description: Specification content, selected packages and research records exist. Content availability differs from publication, neutral stewardship, processor conformance and operational integration.

capabilities.name: Systemic primitive vocabulary
capabilities.blurb: Describe structure, behavior, interactions and governance through eight common subject types whose domain vocabulary and constraints are expressed by Archetypes. This supplies a typed basis for scoped system modeling, not proof that the fixed core is universally adequate.

capabilities.name: Open domain typing
capabilities.blurb: Extend domain vocabulary and constraints with governed Archetypes grounded in the fixed GSM subject types, while the Ascription lifecycle gives changes versioned review and activation semantics. Extension does not add subject types; processors must implement the specified typing and lifecycle rules.

capabilities.name: Governance grammar and lifecycle
capabilities.blurb: Connect governance scope and evaluable constraints to immutable snapshots that progress through review, activation, suspension and retirement. Current DNA grammar and lifecycle content exist in source, with publication pending; enforcement belongs to processors, and future grammar extensions require accepted Change Proposals.

capabilities.name: Selected framework and regulation sourcing
capabilities.blurb: Bring selected architecture, quality, security and regulatory concerns into a common governance vocabulary with reviewable source mappings and reusable templates. Existing content is selectively scoped and legal templates remain unbound; adopter interpretation, full coverage, future frameworks and update delivery are separate responsibilities.

capabilities.name: Selected protocol and domain vocabulary
capabilities.blurb: Describe IT subjects, their protocol interactions and evidence attribution using reusable domain and protocol vocabulary. Selected HTTP, IT and PROV content exists, while other protocols are planned; these schemas neither dispatch interactions nor populate or verify provenance automatically.

capabilities.name: Profile-scoped definition interchange
capabilities.blurb: Specify definition interchange that preserves subject types, Archetype constraints, governance relationships and lifecycle meaning across an explicit conformance profile. Qualification compares processor exports and imports; independent compatibility evidence and preservation of nonconformant DRAFTs remain gates before complete-migration claims.

capabilities.name: Research-informed model evolution
capabilities.blurb: Connect hypotheses about system behavior and governance to case evidence, recorded decisions and proposed model revisions. Research records support scrutiny, not accepted semantics: conceptual cases differ from executed experiments, and normative evolution requires discriminating evidence and accepted Change Proposals.

products.name: Specifications
products.tagline: Define systems and governance with a shared, extensible language.
products.description: GSM 1.0 source content specifies eight primitives, Archetypes, DNA grammar and the Ascription lifecycle. Document-set publication is pending. Processor conformance and neutral stewardship are separate adoption steps; OASIS candidacy is not endorsement.

features.name: Eight systemic primitives

milestone.label: Normative content frozen — Systemic Primitives, DNA grammar, Archetyping, lifecycle (publication of the document set pending)

solutions.name: SAF
solutions.excerpt: Local control foundations, SAFe-shaped method content and planned distribution and sourcing integrations.
solutions.tagline: The Systemic Agentic Framework: local agentic workflows, explicit artifact contracts and planned evidence-backed SIE integration.
solutions.description: Deterministic decisions support probabilistic agents on declared hosts. Artifact quality, authenticated human gates and effect safety need acceptance; documents are not automatically tested or deployed systems.

capabilities.name: Deterministic workflow controls
capabilities.blurb: Coordinate eligible workflow steps, task-specific model routes and resolved guidance against recorded outcomes, making local orchestration decisions traceable. Resolution and journals exist on supported adapters; hosts dispatch work, guidance does not prove adherence, and generated content remains probabilistic.

capabilities.name: Scoped artifact contract checks
capabilities.blurb: Turn shared artifact schemas and templates into checks on mediated write sets so delivery outputs can be validated against declared contracts. Structured-data and Markdown-metadata checks exist; contract resolution, parsing and atomicity remain integration boundaries, while substantive prose quality and unmediated writes are outside their coverage.

capabilities.name: Agentic SAFe operating model
capabilities.blurb: Organize agentic delivery responsibilities and ceremonies through a shared catalogue of roles, workflow sequences, practice playbooks and versioned instructions. Role and guidance content exists; workflow alignment and behavioral quality remain under integration, and execution needs accepted harness, template and host combinations.

capabilities.name: Human-gated advancement
capabilities.blurb: Make workflow advancement depend on review decisions bound to exact revisions and scope, supported by eligible-step resolution, agent write grants and recorded outcomes. Authenticated human approval is planned; existing sequencing, grants and journals do not prove human identity or acceptance.

capabilities.name: Local-first delivery plane
capabilities.blurb: Maintain a local delivery baseline by combining Git-backed artifacts, separate execution journals and contract checks when agent outputs are reconciled. Manual setup is available; collaboration, contract integration and transaction behavior remain incomplete. Installer and CI/publication pipelines are planned optional extensions, independent of hosted offerings.

capabilities.name: Delivery evidence sourcing
capabilities.blurb: Combine versioned workspace artifacts with captured execution journals to derive reviewable definition candidates carrying provenance and uncertainty. Bridge inference and draft promotion are planned; evidence covers captured work only, and contributions establish neither accepted definitions nor tested or deployed systems.

products.name: Agentic Harness
products.tagline: Give local agentic work explicit steps, artifact checks and traceable decisions.
products.description: On supported host adapters, the harness resolves workflow steps and model profiles, supplies instructions, checks mediated writes and records invocations. Checks cover declared schemas and Markdown metadata. Authenticated human approval is planned; atomic writes and cross-host compatibility remain integration boundaries.

qualityCategories.name: Governability
qualityCategories.lead: Who decided what, on which revision, and what the decision does not assert.

qualityCategories.name: Determinism
qualityCategories.lead: Reproducible outcomes from pinned inputs, so probabilistic work never becomes the authority.

qualityCategories.name: Isolation
qualityCategories.lead: Every read, write and disclosure resolves inside a declared boundary.

qualityCategories.name: Openness
qualityCategories.lead: Definitions, provenance and terms can be inspected rather than taken on trust.

qualities.name: Model independence
qualities.claim: Governance does not depend on one provider
qualities.body: Model profiles support selection for bounded tasks. Each host mapping and model change needs compatibility and quality checks.

qualities.name: Local and sovereign execution
qualities.claim: Define the data boundary explicitly
qualities.body: Local execution supports control, but models, tools, telemetry, remotes and backups can transmit data. Egress and retention policies remain necessary.

qualities.name: Cloud where appropriate
qualities.claim: Managed infrastructure without ceding control
qualities.body: Deploy services through managed infrastructure where it makes sense, while the control boundary stays explicit rather than assumed.

qualities.name: Vendor-neutral standard
qualities.claim: Governance you can inspect, not a black box
qualities.body: GSM is a candidate common Definition model. Interchange requirements support inspectability; compatible consumers and draft-preserving migration still need acceptance.

qualities.name: Open and inspectable
qualities.claim: Trust cannot be proprietary
qualities.body: GSM specification content exists in source, with publication pending. SAF local tools use Apache-2.0; SIE and the planned bridge have separate licenses. Inspect each product and its terms.

qualities.name: Git repositories
qualities.claim: Planned candidates from pinned revisions
qualities.body: Supported analysis is planned to produce reviewable candidates. Acquisition, conflict reduction and governed registration are distinct steps.

qualities.name: API contracts
qualities.claim: The interaction surface of your estate
qualities.body: Planned adapters describe declared interaction surfaces with explicit coverage. Contracts alone do not prove actual traffic or applicable obligations.

qualities.name: SBOMs
qualities.claim: Planned dependency evidence
qualities.body: SBOM analysis identifies declared dependencies in a supported scope. Presence does not prove deployed use, reachability or compliance.

qualities.name: Infrastructure
qualities.claim: Separate intent from observations
qualities.body: Planned infrastructure sourcing reads declared configuration. Deployed identity, observation time and coverage are needed to describe what runs.

qualities.name: Accepted intent
qualities.claim: What the organization has agreed
qualities.body: Reviewed definitions carry the authority of an accepted decision. Acceptance records intent; it does not assert that the estate already matches it.

qualities.name: Inspected revision
qualities.claim: What a pinned source says
qualities.body: Sourced candidates stay bound to the revision they were read from. A source revision is not deployed reality and is reconciled before registration.

qualities.name: Observed deployment
qualities.claim: What was seen running, and when
qualities.body: Deployed observations need an identity, an observation time and a stated coverage. Absent observations are reported as unknown rather than compliant.

qualities.name: Pure verdicts
qualities.claim: The same inputs give the same verdict
qualities.body: Norm evaluation is scoped and side-effect free. Rule and input versions are part of the verdict; continuous operation additionally needs observations and scheduling.

qualities.name: Bounded execution
qualities.claim: Mechanisms run inside a declared sandbox
qualities.body: Mechanism execution is confined to a declared protocol surface. Effect safety and authorized action remain acceptance boundaries.

qualities.name: Explicit unknowns
qualities.claim: Missing evidence is a result, not a pass
qualities.body: Applicability, freshness and unknown states are first-class outcomes. An unevaluated obligation is never reported as satisfied.

qualities.name: Model-native taxonomy
qualities.claim: Each framework keeps its own structure
qualities.body: TOGAF, ISO 25000, GDPR, NIS2 and protocol vocabularies are sourced under their own taxonomies. Composition happens through Directives, not schema cross-references.

qualities.name: Cited provenance
qualities.claim: Every sourced statement names its clause
qualities.body: Sourced Directives and Norms cite the section they derive from. Citation supports review; it does not establish legal completeness.

qualities.name: Stable identity
qualities.claim: Published identifiers are not rewritten
qualities.body: Archetype identifiers are logical and versioned. Content exists in source; publication, neutral stewardship and processor conformance are separate steps.

qualities.name: Runs where you work
qualities.claim: No delivery-plane tenancy to adopt
qualities.body: The harness and workspace operate on local checkouts under Apache-2.0. Hosts and model routes are declared rather than assumed.

qualities.name: Human-gated advancement
qualities.claim: Agents propose; people advance
qualities.body: Workflow advancement passes through explicit gates. Authenticated gates and effect safety need acceptance before autonomous progression is claimed.

qualities.name: Contracted artifacts
qualities.claim: Written artifacts are checked against a schema
qualities.body: Mediated writes are validated against matched schemas. Scope is structured data and Markdown metadata; prose quality has a separate boundary.

qualities.name: Tenant-scoped storage
qualities.claim: Definitions never leave their tenant schema
qualities.body: Retained snapshots and queries resolve within a tenant boundary. Tenant/object authorization across the full API surface is being completed.

qualities.name: Revision-bound decisions
qualities.claim: A decision names the revision it was made on
qualities.body: Transition controls bind a decision to the revision it reviewed, so a stale write is refused rather than silently applied.

qualities.name: Authenticated by default
qualities.claim: Only declared endpoints are public
qualities.body: The authenticated shell exists; health and info endpoints are the declared exceptions. Permissive local behavior stays profile-gated.

qualities.name: Role and attribute access
qualities.claim: Role and attribute both bound the request
qualities.body: Planned enforcement combines role grants with object attributes. External identity synchronization is a separate, recoverable concern.

qualities.name: Named conformance profiles
qualities.claim: Conformance is stated against a profile
qualities.body: Definition interchange is scoped to a declared profile. A processor conforms to profiles it names, not to the model as a whole.

qualities.name: Testable requirements
qualities.claim: Requirements are meant to be executed
qualities.body: Interchange requirements are written to be testable. A conformance suite and compatible consumers still need acceptance.

qualities.name: Qualified model routes
qualities.claim: Ranking alone does not establish suitability
qualities.body: Model profiles are selected by task capability and configured cost ranking. Routes are qualified using retained workload-specific quality, cost and disclosure evidence.

qualities.name: Disclosure limits
qualities.claim: What a route may be told is bounded
qualities.body: Instruction delivery and disclosure limits are evaluated per workload. A host change is a change of behavior, not a configuration detail.

affordances.name: Governed organizational context
affordances.title: Work from shared, typed definitions
affordances.blurb: Establish a common semantic basis for decisions across authors and tools by connecting typed IT inventory, retained definition versions, shared vocabulary and cited dependency analysis. Direct authoring and reviewed sourcing are alternative inputs; integrated authorized selection, interchange and answer quality need acceptance, and accepted intent is not observed live state.
affordances.scope: Definition and specification foundations; integrated authorized use remains incomplete.

affordances.name: Scoped governance composition
affordances.title: Review selected obligations together
affordances.blurb: Bring obligations from selected frameworks and internal policies into a shared scope so adopters can review applicability, overlaps and gaps against the same IT subjects. Sourced vocabulary and templates support planned composition and accountable interpretation; selection establishes neither conflict freedom, legal completeness nor compliance enforcement.
affordances.scope: Content exists; integrated composition and enforcement are planned.

affordances.name: Governance lifecycle
affordances.title: Make review and activation boundaries explicit
affordances.blurb: Connect proposals to accountable review and activation through governance grammar, lifecycle controls and human decision gates. Transition controls exist, while authenticated revision-bound decisions need identity and policy integration; sealing closes collection rather than approving definitions, and research affects model revision only through separately accepted Change Proposals.
affordances.scope: Transition controls exist; authenticated decisions remain incomplete.

affordances.name: Evidence-backed definition sourcing
affordances.title: Review candidates from selected sources
affordances.blurb: Build a reviewable account of IT and delivery work by comparing and reconciling code-derived and delivery-derived evidence as retained candidates with provenance. End-to-end acquisition, review and draft registration are planned; confidence is not truth, source history is not deployed reality, and draft promotion remains separate from acceptance.
affordances.scope: Acquisition and end-to-end review/promotion are planned.

affordances.name: Scoped Norm evaluation
affordances.title: Evaluate identified inputs against supported Norms
affordances.blurb: Produce decision-ready compliance appraisal by combining pure verdicts over pinned rules and inputs with scoped IT measures, findings and corrective review. Planned evaluation preserves unknown and not-applicable states; running-system claims additionally need deployed identity, fresh observations and coverage, continuous appraisal needs scheduling, and results are not compliance certification.
affordances.scope: Complete pure verdicts and continuous appraisal are planned.

affordances.name: Bounded generative delivery
affordances.title: Generate artifacts through declared workflows
affordances.blurb: Produce grounded artifacts from selected definitions through bounded workflow orchestration, declared operations, artifact contracts and accountable review, retaining outputs and execution evidence in a local delivery baseline. Local controls exist; integrated generation, effect safety and authenticated human gates need acceptance. Reviewed documents do not establish tested code, authorized deployment or operational feedback; hosting is optional.
affordances.scope: Local controls exist; integrated generation/effects need acceptance.

realizations.scope: Authorized read-only API or MCP context; directly authored or reviewed sourced inputs.
Pinned supplied-instance evaluation without effects or operational-correspondence claims.
Local artifact work on supported hosts, independent of hosted operation.
Current grammar content in source, not publication or processor acceptance.

governed-context.scope: Authorized API context over typed retained definitions; browser reasoning and broader interchange are separate.

governance-fabric.scope: Integrated IT binding and review of selected framework content, not content availability alone.

governance-lifecycle.scope: Accepted SIE lifecycle controls implementing the current grammar; research and SAF human gates are separate.

truth-sourcing.scope: Accepted IT or SAF candidate sourcing with contribution intake; neither intake alone nor automatic promotion.

norm-evaluation.scope: Accepted pure supplied-instance verdict route; continuous IT appraisal is an additional scope.

generative-delivery.scope: Accepted local workflow, artifact, method and workspace combination; IT generation and effectful execution are separate.
